title: The Starving Pilgrims
text: A line of pilgrims in rags shuffles past, going the way you came, too thin to walk much further. Their lips are cracked, their bones showing through their skin. They do not ask for anything. They only look.

options.label: Share what food there is, though you will go hungrier for it.

outcomes.text: They go on, and you go hungrier. Word of it will reach town before you do.

options.label: Point them home and walk on; you cannot feed everyone.

outcomes.text: They do not thank you. They only keep looking.

options.label: The Leader takes their last coins; they will not live to spend them.

outcomes.text: It is easy. Nobody looks at anyone for the rest of the day.
